note: 夜晚內容大方向：少量採集、拍照景點、部落活動或故事（方向，不是限制）。冬季拍照 P30 也放這裡。

review: 黑翅飛魚傳說的公開版本與講述方式

steps.text: 晚上坐上主人家的涼亭，聽長輩說可以公開的故事
steps.textEn: At night, sit on the host family's pavilion and hear the elder tell a story that can be shared

lines.zh: 晚上，大家坐上主人家的涼亭，海風吹過來。
lines.en: At night, everyone sits on the host family's pavilion as the sea breeze blows.

lines.zh: 晚上涼快，來坐。今天說一個大家都可以聽的故事。
lines.en: It's cool at night. Come sit. Today I'll tell a story everyone can hear.

lines.zh: 很久以前，我們的祖先不懂飛魚，什麼魚都一起煮，結果生病了。
lines.en: Long ago, our ancestors didn't understand flying fish. They cooked every fish together, and they got sick.

lines.zh: 後來黑翅膀的飛魚來到夢裡，教祖先什麼時候捕、怎麼煮、哪些不能混在一起。
lines.en: Then a black-winged flying fish came in a dream and taught them when to catch, how to cook, and what must never be mixed.

lines.zh: 所以飛魚的規矩不是隨便定的，是飛魚教我們的。
lines.en: So the flying fish rules weren't made up. The flying fish taught them to us.

lines.zh: 這是流傳較廣的版本，各部落說法不同，還要請族人確認。
lines.en: This is the most widely told version. Each village tells it differently; it still needs checking with the community.

toastEn: "The black-winged flying fish" was added to your notebook.

hint.zh: 晚上主人家的長輩常在涼亭上乘涼，說不定會說故事。
hint.en: At night, the host family's elder often relaxes on the pavilion. Maybe there'll be a story.

name.zh: 頭燈下的潮間帶（只看不採）
name.en: Tide flats by headlamp (look, don't pick)

steps.text: 黃昏退潮、天色變暗時，戴頭燈到東清灣潮間帶觀察
steps.textEn: At dusk low tide, as it gets dark, wear a headlamp and explore the tide flats at Dongqing Bay

lines.zh: 白天看不到的生物，天一暗就出來了。
lines.en: Creatures you can't see by day come out once it gets dark.

lines.zh: 把燈光壓低，看完就把石頭放回原位。寄居蟹已記進圖鑑。
lines.en: Keep your light low and put stones back after looking. The hermit crab is now in your field guide.

hint.zh: 夜裡退潮的時候，帶著頭燈去潮間帶，會看到白天沒有的生物。
hint.en: At low tide at night, take a headlamp to the tide flats and you'll see creatures you don't see by day.

name.zh: 路邊的蘭嶼角鴞（不打閃光）
name.en: Lanyu scops owl by the road (no flash)

review: 族人對貓頭鷹的看法與禁忌
是否適合由族人角色帶隊

text.unlockEn: Lanyu scops owl field guide, photo

steps.text: 晚上在漁人到椰油的路邊，安靜聽角鴞的叫聲，遠遠拍一張
steps.textEn: At night on the road from Iratay to Yayo, quietly listen for the scops owl and take one photo from afar

lines.zh: 長輩不太喜歡在晚上談這種鳥，我們安靜看就好，不要學牠叫。
lines.en: The elders don't really like talking about this bird at night. Let's just watch quietly and not copy its call.

lines.zh: 不打閃光、不放音樂引牠，遠遠拍一張就走。
lines.en: No flash, no music to lure it. Take one photo from afar and move on.

lines.zh: 蘭嶼角鴞已記進圖鑑。
lines.en: The Lanyu scops owl is now in your field guide.

hint.zh: 聽說晚上沿著西岸的路，有時候會聽到「咕——咕」的叫聲。
hint.en: They say that at night along the west coast road, you sometimes hear a "coo— coo" call.

review: 晚會的形式（現代社區活動，非祭儀）

text.unlock: 漁人族人的信任、晚會照片
text.unlockEn: Trust of the Iratay villagers, party photo

steps.text: 晚上三人一起到漁人的學校操場參加晚會
steps.textEn: At night, all three go to the Iratay school field for the evening party

lines.zh: 你們來啦！先拿東西吃，孩子們等一下要唱歌。
lines.en: You came! Grab something to eat first. The kids will sing soon.

lines.zh: 好熱鬧，好多長輩都來了。
lines.en: So lively. So many elders came.

lines.zh: 我帶著族女幫我編的小袋子來的。
lines.en: I brought the little pouch the Tao woman wove for me.

lines.zh: 很好看。這是我們部落的晚會，不是祭典，大家放輕鬆。
lines.en: It looks lovely. This is our village's evening party, not a ceremony. Everyone relax.

lines.zh: 想拍人之前，先問一聲。
lines.en: Ask before taking photos of people.

steps.text: 向漁人的女性長輩道謝

lines.zh: 吃飽了嗎？地瓜是我們田裡的。下次白天再來幫忙挖。
lines.en: Had enough to eat? The sweet potatoes are from our field. Come help dig some in the daytime.

hint.zh: 漁人的族人邀大家晚上到學校操場參加晚會。
hint.en: The Iratay villagers invite everyone to the evening party at the school field.

name.en: Northeast monsoon on a winter night

steps.text: 冬天晚上，聽主人家長輩說東北季風的季節
steps.textEn: On a winter night, hear the host family elder talk about the northeast monsoon season

lines.zh: 冬天風大浪大，船都拉上岸了。男人補網、修船，女人照顧田、整理家裡。
lines.en: In winter the wind and waves are big, and the boats are all pulled ashore. The men mend nets and fix boats; the women look after the fields and the home.

lines.zh: 海不讓我們出去的時候，就好好休息，等飛魚回來。
lines.en: When the sea won't let us out, we rest well and wait for the flying fish to return.

lines.zh: 原來冬天也有冬天要做的事。
lines.en: So winter has its own work too.

toastEn: "The island in winter" was added to your notebook.

hint.zh: 冬天晚上，主人家長輩會說說季風季節的生活。
hint.en: On winter nights, the host family elder will talk about life in the monsoon season.

steps.text: 晚上在開元港拍港邊的燈火
steps.textEn: Photograph the harbour lights at Kaiyuan Harbour at night

lines.zh: 白天熱鬧的港口，晚上安安靜靜的。
lines.en: The harbour, so busy by day, is calm and quiet at night.

hint.zh: 晚上的開元港燈火很漂亮。
hint.en: The lights of Kaiyuan Harbour are beautiful at night.

steps.text: 晚上在東清灣沙灘拍月亮從海上升起
steps.textEn: At night on the Dongqing Bay beach, photograph the moon rising over the sea

lines.zh: 月光照在海面上，拼板舟的影子也看得到。
lines.en: The moonlight is on the sea. You can even see the shadows of the plank boats.

lines.zh: 不要走到船旁邊，也不要坐在船上。
lines.en: Don't walk up to the boats, and don't sit in them.

hint.zh: 東清灣不只日出漂亮，月亮升起來也很美。
hint.en: Dongqing Bay isn't only lovely at sunrise. The moonrise is beautiful too.

name.zh: 東北季風的浪（從岸上遠拍）
name.en: Northeast monsoon waves (photo from the shore)

steps.text: 冬天在朗島岸邊，遠遠拍季風打上來的浪
steps.textEn: In winter on the Iraraley shore, photograph the monsoon waves from afar

lines.zh: 浪好大，難怪冬天船都不出海。
lines.en: Huge waves. No wonder the boats don't go out in winter.

lines.zh: 風浪大時不要靠近岸邊的礁石。
lines.en: Stay away from the shore rocks when the waves are big.

hint.zh: 冬天東北季風一來，朗島的浪特別大。
hint.en: When the northeast monsoon comes in winter, the waves at Iraraley are especially big.
